items.name: Theme and adaptation
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/style.e (D805): ThemeTokens with fourteen colour roles, seven text roles, spacing, radii, borders, elevation, motion and metrics; resolve for the seven control states over three variants; size_class and adapt for touch, dense desktop and compact; reference in Light, Dark and HighContrast; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_theme on both hosts

items.name: Typed actions and gestures
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e (D806): Change[T] and Submit with fire_change/fire_submit as no-ops when unset; Region with a gesture mask and GestureAction; the runtime arena settling tap, drag start/move/end and hover enter/leave from raw pointer events with an 8 px slop; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_gesture on both hosts

items.name: Focus and shortcuts
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e (D806): Scope with traps_focus bounding Tab/Shift+Tab traversal in preorder with wrapping, up to eight Shortcut entries matched on key and modifiers, Enter as the default action and Escape as the cancel action resolved from the focused element upward; focused() for harnesses; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_gesture on both hosts

items.name: Editable text primitive
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e (D807): Edit node over a caller-owned buffer with caret, anchor selection, hit-test placement and drag selection, typed text and IME composition, Backspace/Delete/Home/End/arrows, single-line submit and multiline breaks, clipboard copy/cut/paste with a runtime fallback, a 32-entry coalescing undo/redo history, and edit_value/edit_selection for harnesses; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_edit on both hosts

items.name: Viewport primitives
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e (D808): Scroll with wheel, content drag through the gesture arena (tap-only regions hand over past the slop), per-frame momentum, Clamp/Bounce overscroll with a spring back, a scrollbar thumb, Change[f32] reports, scroll_to/scroll_offset_of; the lazy form places virtual_count items of virtual_extent from virtual_first with visible_range naming the items to build and the reconciler recycling by key; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_scroll on both hosts

items.name: Semantic primitive
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e and lib/e/ui/accessibility.e (D809): Semantics node with role codes for the fifteen added roles, thirteen states, twelve actions, five relationships by key, live politeness, collection position and level, hidden subtrees left out; editors as text fields with value, selection, SetValue and SetSelection; perform routes offered actions to the semantics callback; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_semantics on both hosts

items.name: Overlay primitives
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e (D810): Overlay node placed after the tree and painted last against an anchor element by key with five placements and an offset, kept inside the window; the topmost overlay under a pointer takes it, a modal one blocks and dismisses, takes the focus when it appears, bounds Tab and restores the focus when it goes; overlay_bounds_of for harnesses; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_overlay on both hosts

items.name: Host capability model
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/window.e and lib/e/ui/input.e (D811): capabilities as style.Capabilities, safe_insets and keyboard_insets, orientation, screens in logical pixels, lifecycle from focus and visibility; Lifecycle, Insets and Back events, the first derived from Focus/Blur, Back dispatched as Escape; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_host on both hosts

items.name: Reference harness
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/testing.e (D812): gesture sequences, keys and focus traversal, the fake IME, semantic queries by role and label, overlay lookup, viewport visibility and the faked host with insets; gallery builds the reference page of every primitive under a theme with its state in Gallery; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_gallery on both hosts

items.name: Content
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D813): text in a role with align, wrap, max_lines and ellipsis (widget.Text carries them now), selectable_text as a read-only editor, rich_text spans side by side with tap regions and the link role, icon, image (unlabelled hidden) and canvas with semantic labels, under a Theme of tokens, fonts and language; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_content on both hosts

items.name: Surfaces
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e and lib/e/ui/style.e (D814): Style gained border, radius and shadow which the widget runtime paints (rounded fills and clips, an inside stroke, an offset shadow); surface/panel/card/group_box/divider/badge/avatar/placeholder as functions under a Theme; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_surface on both hosts

items.name: Primary layout
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e and lib/e/ui/layout.e (D815): row and column as flexes with a gap, wrap as a new layout and node kind breaking lines at the main limit, positioned as a box offset by its margin inside a stack; box, flex, grid and stack from D799; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_layout_primary on both hosts

items.name: Layout adapters
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e (D816): aligned/center as an aligned flex (a placed flex now lays out within its settled size), padded, spacer, constrained on the style, Aspect and Fitted node kinds (the latter painting through a scale transform), responsive by size class at build; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_layout_adapters on both hosts

items.name: Scrolling and insets
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e (D817): scroll_view over a clamped viewport with momentum and a thumb; a Scrollbar node kind linked to a viewport by key, painting the thumb and moving the viewport by a drag; safe_area and keyboard_avoiding padding by insets; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_scroll_view on both hosts

items.name: Button family
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e and lib/e/ui/widget.e (D818): button, icon_button, toggle_button and link as tap-and-hover regions in the look style.resolve gives their state, read through widget.interaction under the theme's runtime; Enter and Space tap a focused region; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_button on both hosts

items.name: Discrete selection
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D819): checkbox and radio as a marked row in a tap region centred in the hit target with checked/mixed/disabled states, radio_group and segmented_control keyed per label with one action each, switch_control as a track and knob under the filled or outlined variant; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_selection on both hosts

items.name: Range selection
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/widget.e and lib/e/ui/control.e (D820): a Slider node kind moved by press, drag, arrow keys, Home and End with step snapping and reported changes, a range with two thumbs the press picks the nearer of; slider and range_slider under the theme; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_slider on both hosts

items.name: Progress
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D822): progress_bar as a rounded track with a proportional fill or a still indeterminate segment, progress_ring as a custom-painted stroked arc of cubic quarter turns, both with the progress role and the busy state; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_progress on both hosts

items.name: Text fields
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e and lib/e/ui/widget.e (D823): a shared field of an outlined surface, editor over placeholder and label; text_field, password_field over a secret editor (asterisk per byte, never copied), search_field with submit and a clear button, text_area rows tall; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_field on both hosts

items.name: Basic choice
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D824): select as an outlined button and a modal overlay menu of menu items with one action each and a toggle the caller keeps, list_box as a clamped viewport of tap rows with the selected state; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_choice on both hosts

items.name: Forms
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D825): field_label with the required asterisk controlling its field, field_message as a live status (assertive and invalid when so), form_field as a group labelled by its label, described by its help and errored by its message with required and invalid as states, form as a scope whose Enter and Escape are the caller's over a column or (expanded) a wrap, validation_summary as an assertive alert of links jumping to their fields; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_form on both hosts

items.name: Disclosure and panes
items.evidence: lib/e/ui/control.e (D826): disclosure as a header button with a painted triangle, expanded and controlling its content group, expander the same on a surface; tabs as plain tab buttons under a tab list with Left and Right as scope shortcuts picking the neighbours, tab_view showing the selected page labelled by its tab; resizable_pane and split_view with a focusable drag handle (a slider in the tree) reporting the pane size clamped to its limits, nudged by the arrow keys; tests/selfhost/fixtures/link/ui_panes on both hosts
